key_insight: Across the [1m(vorticity packing fraction, Reynolds number)[0m space, Eulerian flow states and Lagrangian tracer transport stay tightly coupled in the inverse-cascade regime, but this coupling weakens in the late-time coherent-vortex regime where transport becomes strongly Re-dependent.
engineering_relevance: For 2D decaying Navier--Stokes modeling and tracer-based diagnostics, initial vortex packing is a key control knob for predicting transport, but its predictive power can break down at late times and across Reynolds-number variations.
method: Sweeped a broad [1mVPF--Re parameter space[0m for decaying 2D incompressible Navier--Stokes flow.

watch_item: The reported correspondence may not generalize beyond the explored resolution, integration-time window, and parameter range, especially in the late coherent-vortex regime.
paper_title: Eulerian Lagrangian relations in decaying two dimensional incompressible Navier Stokes fluids across initial vorticity packing and Reynolds number
